_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: ntfy credentials stay on the server through create, edit, replace and clear. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. A local webhook receiver runs at {{URL}}. Every POST or PUT the page sends to /api/notification-channels... is a "save", numbered from 1 in order (the Test button's request is not a save). For save N: call "save N" returns "ok" when the server answered it with a 2xx status and none of the secrets "fake-webhook", "fake-token", "fake-password", "replacement-token" in its answer (otherwise what was wrong, or "none" before that save); call "save N sent" returns the webhook_url, token and password fields of the config the page sent, as a JSON object holding only those present; "save N config" returns the config of the server's answer as JSON; "save N secrets" returns the answer's configured_secrets as JSON. Call "test success" returns the success field of the server's answer to the Test button as JSON ("none" before one); call "received" returns the path of the last request the webhook receiver got ("none" before one). Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "the X button" is the button named exactly X, unless it belongs to a card. "The name input" is the input inside the ".form-group" that has a label whose text is exactly "Display Name". "The webhook input" is "#config-webhook_url". "Open the notifications": press Control+k, fill ".command-palette-input" with "notification", click the first ".command-palette-item", and then the button whose name contains "+ Add Channel" should be visible. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and open the notifications. 2. Click the button whose name contains "+ Add Channel", then the ".provider-btn" whose text is exactly "ntfy". Fill the name input with "Secret ntfy", "#config-server" with "{{URL}}", "#config-topic" with "local-topic", "#config-token" with "fake-token", "#config-username" with "reader" and "#config-password" with "fake-password". Click the "Add Channel" button. Call "save 1" until it returns "ok"; "save 1 secrets" must return ["token","password"]. 3. "The ntfy card" is the ".model-card" containing "Secret ntfy"; click its button named exactly "Edit". "#config-token" should have the value "", the attribute type="password" and the placeholder exactly "Leave blank to keep the saved token on the server"; "#config-password" should have the value "", type="password" and the placeholder exactly "Leave blank to keep the saved password on the server". 4. "The token's clear box" is the checkbox named exactly "Clear saved credential" inside the ".form-group" that contains "#config-token"; "the password's clear box" is the same inside the ".form-group" that contains "#config-password". Click the token's clear box to check it: "#config-token" should be disabled and its placeholder attribute should be "" (empty). Click it again to uncheck it: "#config-token" should be enabled with the placeholder exactly "Leave blank to keep the saved token on the server". 5. Click the "Save" button. Call "save 2" until it returns "ok"; "save 2 sent" must return {} (neither token nor password sent). 6. Click the ntfy card's "Edit" button, fill "#config-token" with "replacement-token", and click the "Save" button. Call "save 3" until it returns "ok"; "save 3 secrets" must return ["token","password"]. 7. Click the ntfy card's "Edit" button: "#config-token" should have the value "". Fill "#config-password" with "unsaved-password", then click the button named exactly "Close modal". Open the notifications again, and click the ntfy card's "Edit" button: "#config-password" should have the value "". 8. Click the token's clear box and then the password's clear box to check both: "#config-token" and "#config-password" should both be disabled, each with the placeholder attribute "". 9. Click the "Save" button. Call "save 4" until it returns "ok"; "save 4 sent" must return {"password":"","token":""} and "save 4 secrets" must return []. 10. Call "stored": it must return "clean" (the server's channel list, and each channel's config, hold no secret).
